opening.argument: The material promotes a cryptocurrency arbitrage service built around a Telegram bot that monitors spreads across exchanges and digital assets and sends signals. The title expressly presents a "24/7 Bitcoin & Cripto Arbitrage Bot sending signal via Telegram!", while the description calls it a "Free custom Telegram bot made for auto monitoring the spread between 12 exchanges and more than 77 digital assets!" It then offers viewers "personal arbitrage signals for free" and directs them to join Telegram communities to contact the promoters. Those combined features establish promotion of a trading-bot or funded-contract returns scheme. Payment, asset transfer, credential requests, and financial outcomes are not established.
